findings.summary: A disabled checked radio becomes the only tab stop, so Tab skips the group. Fix PR https://github.com/mui/base-ui/pull/6193 is open. The gallery's 'Group disabled' demo (disabled group with a checked item) exercises this.
Base UI RadioGroup has no Home/End key support; Radix moves to the last/first enabled radio.
SSR markup has no aria-labelledby on the radiogroup and tabindex=-1 on every radio. Not exercised by the client-rendered gallery.
Radio group indicator not centered in base-ui styles (PR 9763 closed it in the registry; current base-nova file already centers it).

notChecked: Reddit, Hacker News and blog searches (only GitHub issue search API was queried)
390x844 viewport: resize_window did not change window.innerWidth (stayed 1280), so mobile screenshots were not taken
Light mode (browser in dark mode only)
Typecheck, lint, build and check:gallery (not run because the component was flagged)
Pixel-level screenshot comparison of every state at 1280x900 beyond the default, disabled and invalid rows; hover/press feedback not compared

differences.where: Disabled item ('Disabled') and disabled group ('Group disabled')
differences.reference: Disabled radios render at 50% opacity with cursor not-allowed (the disabled: variant matches the button's disabled attribute).
differences.branch: Base UI renders a span with aria-disabled and data-disabled, so the disabled: classes never apply; computed opacity is 1 and cursor is default. Disabled radios look fully enabled.
differences.how: Swap radio-group.tsx for the base-nova registry file, open /gallery#components, section radio-group; compare the 'Disabled' row and the 'Group disabled' row, or read getComputedStyle(el).opacity on [role=radio][aria-disabled=true].

differences.reference: Tab skips the disabled group (order: group 1, group 2, Invalid group, then the select).
differences.branch: The disabled group's checked radio is a tab stop and receives focus (upstream issue mui/base-ui#6179).
differences.how: Focus before the first radio group and press Tab repeatedly; focus lands on the 'Group disabled' radio.

differences.reference: End moves focus to the last enabled radio (and selects it).
differences.branch: End does nothing; focus and selection stay put (upstream issue mui/base-ui#6100).
differences.how: Tab into the first group, press End.

differences.reference: button[role=radio] with aria-checked, data-state, native disabled attribute for disabled items, group is tabindex 0 with aria-required false.
differences.branch: span[role=radio] plus a sibling hidden input type=radio; aria-labelledby points at the hidden input's label; disabled items use aria-disabled instead of the disabled attribute; roving tabindex on spans.
differences.how: Inspect the DOM in the radio-group section.

apiChanges: Imports change to @base-ui/react/radio and radio-group; types become RadioGroupPrimitive.Props and RadioPrimitive.Root.Props
Consumer src/gallery/FormSections.tsx uses only value, defaultValue, disabled, className and aria-invalid; no change expected
notes: Gates were not run (flagged, files restored); values in gates are placeholders for 'not run'. The radix-nova and base-nova registry files differ, so this is not a no-op. Reference and local comparison done in dark mode at 1280 wide only.
reasonNotMoved: Base UI's radio group differs from Radix in ways a user sees and feels: disabled radios render at full opacity with a default cursor (the registry's disabled: classes do not match Base UI's aria-disabled span), Tab lands on a disabled group's checked radio (open upstream bug https://github.com/mui/base-ui/issues/6179, fix PR https://github.com/mui/base-ui/pull/6193), and the End key does nothing (https://github.com/mui/base-ui/issues/6100). Retry once #6179 and #6100 are released and the component's disabled styling uses data-disabled / aria-disabled selectors, then re-run the gallery comparison.
